name: Edoardo Rolla
bio: Young Genoese seaman whom Wilde had written to ahead of his move from Switzerland to Genoa in the first week of April 1899, and hoped to find waiting for him there. Wilde described him to Robert Ross as 'a young lad, by name Edoardo Rolla, one of the sea-farers', with 'fair hair', 'always in dark blue'. No age, dates or other trace appear in the letter, and no record of whether the meeting took place was found in the pages read.
bio_note: Sole source: Wilde to Robert Ross, [early April 1899], Gland, Complete Letters (2000), p. 1140. The general index lists him as 'Rolla, Edoardo (boy)'. Dates: none recorded. Frankel treats him at printed pp. 248 and 250 and indexes him as 'Rolla, Edoardo, 248, 250'; he offers only 'possibly a sailor or fisherman' and no dates. No birth or death date is recorded, and none is likely to be found: the record preserves a first name (or a trade) in another man's correspondence and no surname to search by.
